messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Partial outage detected for inference-api in us-west-2. Elevated TLS handshake failures observed causing 502/524 to calling customers. Auto-pager: oncall-alex, sre-jo, net-eng-simone. Incident channel created.

oncall-alex: ack. I'm on it, pulling up traces and recent deploys. Paging SRE.

sre-jo: oncall-alex hi - I'm joining. Any customer reports yet?

cust-success-mike: we've got 3 customers reporting errors starting ~12:04 UTC; one is showing persistent 524. I can DM logs if needed.

observability-bot: Alerts: TLS_HANDSHAKE_ERRORS > threshold (5m) on inference-api-proxy-usw2. Error rate: 12% -> 27% over 6m.

oncall-alex: first pass: no deploys in last hour. Check load balancer health and proxy TLS term. Can someone run tcpdump on proxy facing interface?

infra-ops-ray: running tcpdump now on proxy-1 (10.12.3.45). Capturing client -> proxy handshake failures. Snippet (filtered):

```
12:06:18.123456 IP 198.51.100.23.443 > 10.12.3.45.55324: Flags [P.], seq 1:512, ack 1, win 64240
12:06:18.123789 IP 10.12.3.45.55324 > 198.51.100.23.443: Flags [R], seq 0, ack 1, win 0
12:06:18.124001 IP 198.51.100.23.443 > 10.12.3.45.55324: TLSv1.3 Handshake, length 512
```

infra-ops-ray: I'm seeing RSTs right after the server sends large handshake packets.

eng-runtime-lena: that looks like fragmentation/MTU. We recently pushed a VPC peering config change across regions last night (MTU clamp?). Simone, any peering changes?

net-eng-simone: I rolled out a change to peering policies at 11:50 UTC to add route filters for new cidr blocks. No MTU changes intended. I'll check route tables and SGs now.

sre-jo: hypothesis list: A) new peering/filtering dropping fragments -> TLS fails; B) cert rotation produced a larger chain and exposed MTU frag issues; C) upstream client library regression.

oncall-alex: good. Let's triage in this order. Simone, can you confirm PMTU on inter-subnet path? Ray, can you capture larger packet sizes and look for ICMP fragmentation-needed messages?

infra-ops-ray: tcpdump with -s 0 capturing full packets. I see occasional ICMP type 3 code 4 from gateway 10.10.1.1 -> 10.12.3.45: "fragmentation needed and DF set". Example:

```
12:07:02.543210 IP 10.10.1.1 > 10.12.3.45: ICMP destination-unreachable (frag needed), mtu 1400
```

infra-ops-ray: so PMTU path reports 1400 instead of expected 1500 on that hop. That matches RSTs after large TLS handshake packets.

eng-runtime-lena: confirming: we rotated TLS certs at 11:58 UTC as part of scheduled rotation. New cert chain is 3 certs (leaf + intermediate + cross-sig) vs previous 2 and handshake size increased ~400 bytes. Could push handshake over 1500 when combined with TCP options.

sre-jo: timeline so far:
- 11:50 UTC: net-eng change deploy (peering route filters)
- 11:58 UTC: runtime cert rotation on proxy cluster
- 12:04 UTC: first customer reports, alerts fire
- 12:06-12:10 UTC: SRE/infra triage (this thread)

oncall-alex: current mitigation options: 1) rollback cert to smaller chain (requires keying, risk), 2) remove DF flag / adjust MTU on proxy host to 1400 temporarily, 3) revert peering change fast-path. Which is quickest?

net-eng-simone: I can roll back route filters in ~6m, but will need a quick approval. Changing MTU on hosts is faster but risky for other traffic.

sre-jo: can we enable TCP MSS clamp on the gateway to 1400 as quick mitigation? Simone, can your team push an ACL/NAT rule?

net-eng-simone: yes, can push MSS clamp on edge gateway to 1400 now. Pushing in 30s.

(30s later)

net-eng-simone: MSS clamp applied on edge gateway 10.10.1.1 -> 1400.

observability-bot: After MSS clamp: TLS_HANDSHAKE_ERRORS down to 4% in 90s. Latency improved.

cust-success-mike: customer reports success after ~12:09 UTC. Thanks team.

oncall-alex: excellent. Keep clamp while we finish RCA. Need root cause evidence. Simone, save config diff and change window. Ray, save tcpdumps. Lena, archive cert chain comparisons.

infra-ops-ray: saved packet captures to s3://redwood-incidents/1962345678/pcap/ and uploaded full tcpdump + ICMP logs.

eng-runtime-lena: archived certs: old_chain.pem (2 certs), new_chain.pem (3 certs). New chain handshake lengths: 1728 bytes vs old 1324 bytes. Pushed to same s3 bucket.

sre-jo: building RCA outline in-thread:
- Impact: clients with path MTU > 1400 got fragmented TLS ClientHello/ServerHello sequences; some middleboxes drop fragments leading to handshake timeouts and client retries -> 502/524.
- Root cause: combined effect of (1) peering change that introduced a hop with lowered MTU (10.10.1.1) and (2) cert rotation that increased TLS handshake packet size beyond the MTU while DF bit was set.
- Contributing factors: lack of PMTU regression test in deploy pipeline; no automatic MSS clamp on gateway for new routes; cert rotation not validated for MTU-sensitive paths.

oncall-alex: agree. Two action items for now: A) revert peering route filter change to restore original path MTU (net-eng); B) add PMTU check into cert rotation playbook (eng-runtime). Also we should add automatic MSS clamp for peering rollouts as a temporary guard.

net-eng-simone: rolling back route filters now (command posted in ops-runbook). Revert complete at 12:18 UTC.

observability-bot: After revert: no new handshake errors in last 5m. Alert lowered.

sre-jo: adding hypotheses verdicts: Hypothesis A (peering/MTU) -> confirmed by ICMP 3/4 and MSS clamp effect. Hypothesis B (cert size) -> confirmed by handshake length diff and timing. Hypothesis C (client lib) -> unlikely; no client library changes observed.

cust-success-mike: I'll notify impacted customers with the summary and timeline. Will include mitigation details and next steps for postmortem.

oncall-alex: Thanks. We'll keep the MSS clamp until net-eng implements a permanent fix or route path restored. Assigning follow-ups: net-eng-simone -> postmortem root cause + revert changelog; eng-runtime-lena -> update cert rotation playbook and add MTU precheck; sre-jo -> add PMTU tests to runbook and add alert for ICMP frag-needed spikes.

sre-jo: I'm going to start the incident RCA doc in Google Drive and will paste link here when ready. Preliminary notes done.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "Mitigated" at 12:25 UTC. Please file postmortem within 72h. :white_check_mark:

oncall-alex: great work everyone. Closing active paging. If anyone finds residual errors, re-open thread or ping oncall.

net-eng-simone: saved config diffs and audit logs to s3://redwood-incidents/1962345678/netdiffs/.

eng-runtime-lena: cert playbook PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/certs/pull/412 - includes MTU check and cert chain size warning.

sre-jo: RCA doc link: https://docs.internal.redwood/incidents/1962345678-rca (draft). I'll include packet capture excerpts and test vectors.

cust-success-mike: sent customer blast. Will share responses in #customer-impact-summary.

oncall-alex: ack. Good job.
